1 compartment: Biota (Biota, Terrestrial)

10 biota samples. Species: Ursus maritimus. Tissue types: Liver. Life stages: Mixed. Genders: Mixed

3 protocols:
Sampling Protocol - Other: (Polar bear samples collected from native subsistence hunts during 2005-2008. Bears of both sexes aged 2 to 29 years.)
Fractionation Protocol - Acid extractable: (Each sample was digested in 0.5 mL of ROP (Reverse Osmosis Purified) water and 1.0 mL of 70% nitric acid overnight at room temperature. The sample was then heated at 100°C for 4 hours and diluted with ROP water to 4 mL.)
Extraction Protocol - Acid digestion: (Each sample was digested in 0.5 mL of ROP (Reverse Osmosis Purified) water and 1.0 mL of 70% nitric acid overnight at room temperature. The sample was then heated at 100°C for 4 hours and diluted with ROP water to 4 mL.)
limitations: All data is from analysed livers. Polar bear age ranges and genders were reported, but copper concentrations were not broken down in this way.

1 protocol:
Analytical Protocol - Inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry: (EPA Method 200.8 with modifications for biological samples. Concentrations measured using ELAN 9000, inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry from Perkin Elmer. CRMs used included Dolt-3, Tort-2, Oyster Tissue 1566b, Bovine Liver 1577a, Bovine Muscle 8414 and Mussel Tissue 2976. Average recoveries ranged from 80.9% for copper to 103.5% for Se.)

criterion_title: Limit of Detection and/or Limit of Quantification
limitations:
Paper reports Practical Detection Limit ranges for analysed substances:
"The practical detection limit (PDL; mg L1) is based on a trace
element response that is 5 times the theoretical detection limit
(TDL). The TDL (mg L1) is a response that is based on 3 times
the standard deviation of the analysis noise. The PDLs for total
Hg, As, Cu, Cd, Hg, Mn, Rb, Se, and Zn ranged from 0.005 (Cd)
to 5.5 (Zn) mg L1. The TDLs for total Hg, As, Cu, Cd, Hg, Mn,
Rb, Se, and Zn ranged from 0.001 (Cd) to 1.1 (Zn) mg L1."
